findings: Faculty clustering is 0.32, against 0.03 in a random graph, 0.13 after degree-preserving rewiring and 0.28 when papers are reshuffled among faculty keeping team sizes (z = 4.3); much of the clustering is what multi-faculty papers produce mechanically, so the paper-level null is the fair baseline.
Only 46% of the 3229 faculty triangles are 'filled' (all three on one paper); the rest close through separate papers, i.e. genuine triadic closure.

Louvain modularity is 0.49 vs 0.20 under the bipartite null, and the best partition matches lab membership with NMI 0.64 (ARI 0.50; permutation z = 70) but departments only with NMI 0.52 (AMI 0.30): communities follow the lab wall more than the department chart.

Adding links through non-faculty lab authors (students, postdocs, staff) raises the faculty LCC from 243 to 256 of 274 faculty, connects 7 of 23 isolates, and moves the cross-lab share of links from 4.8% to 11.1%; counting only short-tenure authors (a proxy for students and postdocs) the LCC is 255 and the cross-lab share 8.2%.

The network densifies with E ~ N^2.65 (95% CI 2.51-2.79; inflated because the roster fixes the node pool, so N saturates) and new links attach with kernel A(k) ~ k^0.40 (CI 0.31-0.50), i.e. sub-linear preferential attachment.
Of 60 cross-lab faculty links, 78% rest on a single joint paper, and removing the 10 papers that create the most cross-lab pairs leaves only 36 (60%) of them.

Early collaboration (2016-20 degree) predicts 2021-26 output by +0.25 log-papers per SD (p = 0.023) beside early papers (+0.32, p = 0.00064); its association with later field-normalised citations is +0.11 per SD (p = 0.079, not significant at 5%). Brokerage (betweenness, constraint) adds nothing once degree and output are controlled.

For future co-authorship, logistic (same lab + topic + log AA), fit 2016-18 -> 2019-20 works best (AUC 0.88, precision@50 38%); cross-lab pairs in the top decile of 2016-20 topic similarity linked in 2021-26 at 0.5% vs 0.2% for other cross-lab pairs (2.3x, 8 of 1627 pairs; Fisher p = 0.053).

Faculty start publishing in a new subfield 5.2x as often when a prior co-author already works there (CI 4.5-5.8), vs 5.6x for future co-authors and 4.1x for random same-lab colleagues (ratio prior/future 0.93, CI 0.80-1.07), so the co-author effect is not distinguishable from shared interest (homophily), not evidence of influence.

The internal citation main path runs 18 papers from 2016 to 2026 and is dominated by CSIR-CDRI; subfield entropy changed CSIR-CCMB 3.47->4.13, CSIR-CDRI 3.95->3.86, CSIR-IGIB 3.99->4.44, CSIR-IMTECH 3.36->3.76 bits (2016 vs 2025, rarefied), with mean top-10 subfield turnover Jaccard CSIR-CCMB 0.41, CSIR-CDRI 0.59, CSIR-IGIB 0.45, CSIR-IMTECH 0.48.

methods.network: Faculty co-authorship on papers with <= 50 authors; all 274 faculty with papers are nodes.
methods.null_models: 100 draws each: G(n,m); double-edge-swap rewiring (10 m swaps); faculty-paper incidence shuffled keeping paper and faculty degrees (duplicates repaired by swaps), then projected. Metrics unweighted; Louvain seed 42.
methods.filled_triangles: A triangle is filled when one paper (<= author cap) carries all three faculty.
methods.communities: Weighted Louvain on non-isolated faculty over 50 seeds; best-modularity partition compared with lab and lab|department labels by NMI/ARI/AMI; z from 1000 label permutations.
methods.kcore: Unweighted core numbers on the full faculty graph; main core = highest k.
methods.students: Non-faculty authors affiliated with our labs (not matched to any roster author ID) on papers within the author cap; a faculty pair is mediated when both wrote (on any papers) with the same such author but never with each other. 'Short tenure' = active in our corpus for <= 6 calendar years (a censored proxy for students and postdocs).
methods.growth: Cumulative network per year; alpha from OLS of log E on log N (t interval); effective diameter = 90th percentile of LCC shortest paths.
methods.preferential_attachment: Node-years (degree at end of t-1, new links in t); A(k) = links gained / node-years at k; gamma from log cumulative kernel ~ (gamma+1) log k over k = 1..95th percentile; CI from 500 faculty-cluster bootstraps.
methods.position_model: Faculty with >= 2 papers 2016-20; network measures on the 2016-20 graph (isolate constraint set to 1); OLS with HC1 errors and lab fixed effects; ncs = citations / mean of dataset papers with the same subfield and year.
methods.fragility: Node cut via node-splitting max-flow between all faculty of two labs within the LCC (cut may include their own faculty); top papers ranked by cross-lab faculty pairs created.
methods.link_prediction: Candidates = unlinked pairs of faculty active 2016-20 and 2021-26; scores from the 2016-20 graph and subfield vectors; AUC CI from 500 stratified bootstraps; precision@50 with random tie-breaking; logistic weights fitted on 2016-18 -> 2019-20.
methods.twins: Cross-lab pairs, each with >= 5 papers, never on any paper together, ranked by all-years subfield cosine.
methods.contagion: Rows = (faculty active in year t with earlier papers, t in 2018-2026, subfield not yet used); adoption = first paper in that subfield in t; exposure = a qualifying alter published there before t; relative risk with 500 faculty-cluster bootstraps; random placebo averages 20 size-matched draws.
methods.main_path: Internal citations ordered by (year, publication date, id), backward edges dropped; SPC edge weight = paths into citing paper x paths out of cited paper; global main path maximises summed SPC.
methods.entropy: Shannon entropy (bits) of each lab's subfield distribution per year, also rarefied to a common sample size; turnover = Jaccard of top-10 subfields vs previous year.
